commentary: Market breadth at 66.6% indicates that equity participation remains healthy despite recent tech consolidation, while fixed income assets continue to trade below their 200-day moving averages under ongoing interest rate pressure. The portfolio is currently carrying excess uninvested cash of nearly 25%, leaving it under-allocated to active momentum. We are deploying this cash into high-conviction equity leaders and real estate while keeping the bond sleeve light to protect against duration drag. What would change our mind is market breadth dropping below 50% alongside broad equity index breakdowns below 200-day averages, which would trigger a aggressive shift toward capital preservation.
allocation_reason: A 0.30 bond weight sits just 0.05 above the 0.25 minimum floor and 0.45 below the 0.75 maximum ceiling. We maintain this lower-tier allocation because fixed income instruments (IEF, AGG, TLT) remain below their 200-day moving averages and offer minimal downside hedging efficiency in the current rate environment.
